caseName: Young v. United States ex rel. Vuitton
caseNameFull: Young v. United States ex rel. Vuitton et Fils S.A. and Klayminc v. United States ex rel. Vuitton et Fils S.A.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Motion of petitioner in No. 85-6207 for leave to proceed informa pauperis granted. Certio-rari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 780 F. 2d 179.
